study type: Network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies
outcome: Units of red blood cells transfused
Use of additional post-operative bilateral uterine artery embolization
cohort: The cohort comprised 6973 women with antenatally suspected or confirmed placenta accreta spectrum or placenta previa undergoing planned cesarean delivery.
finding: Prophylactic endovascular procedures, particularly aortic balloon occlusion (REBOA), were associated with significantly reduced perioperative blood loss, peripartum hysterectomy rates, and other complications in women with abnormal placentation.
mod_finding: All findings are specific to interventions performed during planned cesarean delivery for women with abnormal placentation, showing improved outcomes within this mode of birth.
